points.K8: 天花板过滤，属于工程控制
points.K9: 定向气流，各级实验室都有
points.K11: 病原体工作只在最里间

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一扇带观察窗的白色门前，转身面对镜头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a white door with a small viewing window and turns to face the camera.
shots.narration: 今天讲一堵看不见的墙。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手，身边飘过几道淡蓝色气流箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves a paw while light blue airflow arrows drift past beside it.
shots.narration: 它是用空气砌成的。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验楼走廊里，看着门上贴的空白警示牌和生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in a white laboratory corridor looking at a door with a biohazard warning sign and a blank notice.
shots.narration: 阿杰要去参观高等级实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰拉门，门很沉，一股风从门缝往里吸，他的衣角被吹动
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls a heavy door open and his shirt flutters as air is drawn inward through the gap.
shots.narration: 门一开，衣角被风往里吸。

shots.scene: 王老师站在走廊里，招手示意阿杰先别进
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator in the corridor raises a hand, signalling the young male student to wait.
shots.narration: 王老师说：先弄懂这阵风。

shots.scene: 剖面图：一个封闭房间，箭头全部从外向里
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a sealed room with every airflow arrow pointing from outside to inside. No people.
shots.narration: 防护实验室靠定向气流，

shots.scene: 房间里的小红点被向里的箭头包围，出不去
shots.prompt_en: Small red dots inside the room are surrounded by inward arrows and cannot get out. No people.
shots.narration: 把病原体关在一个封闭空间里。

shots.scene: 欣欣在示意图旁竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up next to the diagram.
shots.narration: 这就是防护最基本的想法。

shots.scene: 王老师和阿杰站在一段狭长的白色小间里，前后各一扇门
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the young male student stand in a narrow white chamber with a door at each end.
shots.narration: 这一小段叫气锁。

shots.scene: 示意图：气锁颜色最浅，加号图标，箭头从中间向两侧推出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the airlock in the middle is marked with a plus icon and arrows push outward to both sides. No people.
shots.narration: 气锁里保持的是正压，

shots.scene: 两侧的空气被挡在门外
shots.prompt_en: Air from both sides is blocked at the doors by the outward arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 两边的空气都进不来。

shots.scene: 阿杰透过一侧观察窗看到室外的树和停车场
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks through a viewing window on one side and sees trees and a parking lot outside.
shots.narration: 这一侧，通向外部环境；

shots.scene: 阿杰转身，透过另一侧观察窗看到长长的实验走廊
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns and looks through the window on the other side at a long laboratory corridor.
shots.narration: 那一侧，就是防护区。

shots.scene: 商场门口上方的风幕向下吹出一道气流
shots.prompt_en: Above a shop entrance, an air curtain blows a sheet of air straight down. No people.
shots.narration: 可以把它想成商场门口的风幕。

shots.scene: 一道向下的气流隔开两侧，红点被挡在一边
shots.prompt_en: A downward sheet of air separates two sides, and red dots stay on one side. No people.
shots.narration: 一道气流，把病原体挡在里面。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在风幕图标下，双手往下压
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands under an air curtain icon and pushes both paws downward.
shots.narration: 向下的风，把病原体锁在防护区。

shots.scene: 王老师推开下一扇门，两人走进一段新走廊
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator pushes open the next door and the two walk into another corridor.
shots.narration: 往里走，下一区是负压。

shots.scene: 墙上监测面板特写：绿色指示灯亮，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a wall monitoring panel with a green indicator light on and a blank screen. No people.
shots.narration: 面板绿灯，说明压力正常。

shots.scene: 示意图：负压区标减号，箭头只朝里
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the zone marked with a minus icon, with arrows pointing only inward. No people.
shots.narration: 负压保证空气只往里流。

shots.scene: 剖面图：负压区的空气流向一个滤网盒，再流向室外
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram: air from the negative pressure zone flows into a filter box and then outdoors. No people.
shots.narration: 要排出去的空气，

shots.scene: 滤网盒特写，带着红点的气流进入，干净气流出来
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the filter box: air with red dots goes in and clean air comes out. No people.
shots.narration: 必须先过高效空气过滤器。

shots.scene: 放大镜下的滤材：杂乱交织的纤维网
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over the filter material showing a tangled mesh of fibers. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤器里是层层纤维，

shots.scene: 红点撞上纤维被粘住，空气从缝隙穿过
shots.prompt_en: Red dots hit the fibers and stick, while air passes through the gaps. No people.
shots.narration: 大部分病原体和颗粒被截住。

shots.scene: 滤材旁一把小尺子图标，标着 0.22
shots.prompt_en: A tiny ruler icon beside the filter material, with a small scale mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这种过滤器的规格是0.22微米。

shots.scene: 滤网表面积满小点
shots.prompt_en: The surface of a pleated filter covered with many tiny trapped dots. No people.
shots.narration: 病原体被截在里面，干净空气出去。

shots.section_title: 天花板过滤，属于工程控制
shots.scene: 阿杰抬头看天花板上的排风口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks up at an exhaust grille in the ceiling.
shots.narration: 负压区的风，被引向天花板。
overlay: 天花板过滤，属于工程控制

shots.section_title: 天花板过滤，属于工程控制
shots.scene: 剖面图：天花板风口后面是过滤器，再接风管通到室外
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram: behind the ceiling grille is a filter, then a duct leading outdoors. No people.
shots.narration: 经过顶上的过滤器才排出。

shots.section_title: 天花板过滤，属于工程控制
shots.scene: 房子图标和齿轮图标合成一面盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A building icon and a gear icon merge into a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这种靠设施的措施叫工程控制。

shots.section_title: 定向气流，各级实验室都有
shots.scene: 三栋大小不同的实验室小楼，每栋都有向里的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Three laboratory buildings of different sizes, each with inward airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 定向气流的工程控制，
overlay: 定向气流，各级实验室都有

shots.section_title: 定向气流，各级实验室都有
shots.scene: 三栋楼上方各一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: A green check mark appears above each of the three buildings. No people.
shots.narration: 是生物安全实验室的常见配置。

shots.scene: 王老师站在墙上一张空白平面图前，指着入口
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at a blank floor plan on the wall and points at the entrance.
shots.narration: 从入口一路往里走，

shots.scene: 平面图上颜色由浅到深，压力表指针逐级下降
shots.prompt_en: On the floor plan the colors go from light to dark while a row of blank gauges shows the needle dropping step by step. No people.
shots.narration: 负压一级比一级大。

shots.scene: 箭头沿颜色变深的方向流动，红点被推到最深处
shots.prompt_en: Arrows flow toward the darkest area and the red dots are pushed to the deepest room. No people.
shots.narration: 病原体就被限制在最里面。

shots.section_title: 病原体工作只在最里间
shots.scene: 平面图上三个深红色房间被圈出
shots.prompt_en: Three dark red rooms are circled on the floor plan. No people.
shots.narration: 所有涉及病原体的工作，
overlay: 病原体工作只在最里间

shots.section_title: 病原体工作只在最里间
shots.scene: 三个房间里各有生物安全柜图标、试管图标
shots.prompt_en: Each of the three rooms shows a biological safety cabinet icon and a test tube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 诊断和实验，都只在这三间做。

shots.scene: 平面图分成红色区和白色区
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan divided into a red area and a white area. No people.
shots.narration: 平面图上，红色是污染区，

shots.scene: 白色区里有更衣室、库房、办公室图标
shots.prompt_en: The white area holds icons of a changing room, a store room and an office. No people.
shots.narration: 白色是清洁区。

shots.scene: 交界处有更衣室、淋浴、双门高压灭菌器、传递窗图标
shots.prompt_en: At the border are icons of a changing room, a shower, a double-door autoclave and a pass-through box. No people.
shots.narration: 交界处是更衣、淋浴和灭菌设施。

shots.scene: 门上：生物危害警告标志和禁止入内标志
shots.prompt_en: A door with a biohazard warning sign and a no entry sign. No people.
shots.narration: 防护区门口贴着生物危害标志。

shots.scene: 阿杰停在门口，王老师拿出空白授权名单核对
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops at the door while the safety administrator checks a blank authorization list.
shots.narration: 没有授权，谁都不能进去。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现向里的箭头和压力表图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside inward arrows and a pressure gauge icon.
shots.narration: 定向气流，越往里负压越大。

shots.scene: 滤网图标和天花板风口图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a filter and a ceiling exhaust grille. No people.
shots.narration: 排风先过滤，这叫工程控制。

shots.scene: 红白分区平面图、气锁、禁止入内三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a red and white floor plan, an airlock and a no entry sign. No people.
shots.narration: 正压气锁，分清区域，未授权不进。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼走廊里，向镜头挥手，身边气流箭头轻轻流向门内
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in the laboratory corridor waving goodbye, with gentle airflow arrows flowing toward the door.
shots.narration: 风往里吹，安全往外传，再见！
